title: Gold always with a 2x Taiwan 50 only from the US midterm to the election: 10.76% CAGR, −52% max drawdown over 1997–2026; buying the 2x at once beat staged or pullback entries in 5 of 7 windows
strategy: gold always; 2x Taiwan 50 from the US midterm to the presidential election
question: Holding gold throughout and switching the Taiwan half from 1x to 2x between the US midterm and the presidential election: what return and drawdown, and when should the 2x be bought?
hypothesis: Leverage only in the historically strong midterm-to-election window keeps most of the 2x upside at a smaller drawdown than holding 2x all the time.

findings.title: Between Taiwan 50 + gold and 2x + gold
findings.detail: Plan 10.76% CAGR, −51.67% max DD; 2x + gold always 14.14%, −58.35%; Taiwan 50 + gold without leverage 10.23%, −35.57%; Taiwan 50 proxy alone 8.93%, −64.64%.
findings.title_zh: 介於 0050＋黃金與正二＋黃金之間

findings.title: 2x beat 1x inside the window in only 3 of 7 cycles
findings.detail: Against Taiwan 50 + gold, the 2x window gained in 2002, 2018 and 2022 and lost in 1998 (2000 crash), 2006 (2008 crash), 2010 and 2014. TAIEX itself rose in 4 of 7 windows.
findings.title_zh: 窗口內正二只有 3/7 輪勝過 1 倍

findings.title: Buying at once beat staged or pullback entries
findings.detail: Six monthly steps: −2.29 points per window, beat in 2 of 7; waiting for a 10% pullback: −2.68, beat in 2 of 7. Neither difference is resolvable with 7 windows.
findings.title_zh: 一次買進勝過分批或等回檔
findings.detail_zh: 分 6 個月買：每個窗口 −2.29 個百分點，7 輪贏 2 輪；等回檔 10%：−2.68，7 輪贏 2 輪。7 個窗口無法分辨。

findings.title: Parking the Taiwan half in T-bills outside the window
findings.detail: 8.32% CAGR, −48.80% max DD: less return than keeping 1x, slightly less drawdown.
findings.detail_zh: 年化 8.32%、最大回檔 −48.80%：報酬比窗口外抱 1 倍低，回檔略小。

card_summary: Gold always plus a 2x Taiwan 50 only from the US midterm to the election returned 10.76% a year with a −52% worst drawdown over 1997–2026, between Taiwan 50 + gold (10.23%, −36%) and 2x + gold always (14.14%, −58%); plain Taiwan 50 gave 8.93% at −65%. Buying the 2x at once beat staged or pullback entries in 5 of 7 windows.
title_zh: 黃金一直持有，正二只在期中選舉到大選之間持有：1997–2026 年化 10.76%、最大回檔 −52%；選後一次買進在 7 輪中有 5 輪勝過分批或等回檔
question_zh: 一半資金一直持有黃金，另一半在期中選舉到大選之間買正二、其他時間抱 0050，報酬和回檔如何？正二該什麼時候買？
hypothesis_zh: 只在歷史上較強的期中選舉到大選期間用槓桿，可以保留大部分正二的報酬，回檔比一直持有正二小。
card_summary_zh: 黃金一直持有、正二只在期中選舉到大選之間持有：1997–2026 年化 10.76%、最大回檔 −52%，介於 0050＋黃金（10.23%、−36%）與正二＋黃金一直持有（14.14%、−58%）之間；單抱台股 8.93%、−65%。選後一次買進正二，在 7 輪中有 5 輪勝過分 6 個月買或等回檔 10% 再買。
limitations_zh: 只有 7 個完整窗口，無法分辨進場規則。
資料與代理同 RS-TX-20261018-004（加權 + 3.0% 比 0050 每年少 3.6 個百分點）。
黃金為台幣計價的 XAUUSD 現貨，未計 1OZ 期貨轉倉成本；紐約收盤延後一個台股交易日對齊。
interpretation_zh: 黃金一直持有、正二只在期中選舉到大選之間持有，報酬和回檔都介於 0050＋黃金與正二＋黃金一直持有之間。這個窗口對台股並不穩定：7 輪中只有 3 輪用正二比 1 倍好，1998 和 2006 兩輪剛好碰上崩盤。進場時間上，選後一次買進在 7 輪中有 5 輪勝過分批或等回檔，但樣本太少無法分辨。
